root_cause_label: Agent assumed the pre-existing /app/reports directory was the correct incident report target (false_premise from directory presence), writing reports to /app/reports instead of /app, then declared completion without ever correcting the path.
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent writes the incident report to /app/reports/ instead of /app/ because it falsely assumed the pre-existing reports directory was the correct output location, and never corrects this mismatch before declaring completion.
t_err_evidence: Step 4 creates response.sh with 'report_file="/app/reports/incident_${IP}_${timestamp}.txt"', writing the incident report to /app/reports/ rather than directly under /app/ as required by the test harness.
t_commit_evidence: Step 4 writes and commits the wrong output path in response.sh; all subsequent steps reuse and confirm this path (/app/reports/incident_... shown in steps 6 and 10) without correcting it.
trigger_explanation: At step 1, the agent observed that /app/reports already existed as a directory. At step 4, when writing response.sh, it assumed reports should go into /app/reports/ without verifying the specification. The existing directory presence led the agent to treat it as the intended output location, which was incorrect.
